posts.author: KarthikAcharya
posts.text: Is it Cas effect? — Yes, you can place AMO intraday orders. When you place an AMO with the Intraday (MIS). The order is sent at 9:00 AM and may participate in the pre-open session. If it gets executed, it becomes an intraday position and needs to be squared off the same day. If it isn’t executed in pre-open, the unexecuted order moves to the normal market session and can get executed later if your price is available.

posts.author: TraderJini
posts.text: CAS needs to be rolled back — No. A closing price of ₹1,300 doesn’t mean someone necessarily bought the stock at ₹1,300. The closing price is the exchange’s official end-of-day price, calculated as per its prescribed mechanism. It’s mainly used as a reference to value holdings at the end of the day. So if you own Axis Bank bought at ₹1,250 and it closes at ₹1,300, you have an unrealised gain of ₹50/share not because you sold at ₹1,300, but because that’s the day’s closing valuation.
